title: Size Shift
concept: The dot auto‑advances through a scrolling tunnel; each tap toggles its radius between small and large, letting you thread through narrow gaps or block wide barriers that only fit the current size.

title: Reverse Run
concept: The dot auto-advances through a scrolling tunnel; tapping rewinds its position and velocity a short interval (e.g., 0.5 s), letting you undo collisions and time your movement.

title: Pulse Ripple
concept: The dot moves forward while a periodic wave expands from its tail; tapping emits a secondary ripple that temporarily reverses the wave direction, letting the dot slip through incoming barriers that sync with the wave phase.

title: Pulse Split
concept: A single dot auto‑moves forward; each tap creates a temporary clone that runs parallel for a short distance, allowing you to thread one through a gap while the original passes elsewhere, then they merge back.

title: Pulse Mirror
concept: The dot moves forward while a periodic pulse expands outward; each tap reflects the pulse back, creating a mirrored wave that can pass through opposite‑side barriers, letting you toggle which side of the tunnel is cleared.

title: Orbit Pulse
concept: A dot orbits a moving nucleus; tapping releases a radial pulse that expands the orbit radius for a brief window, letting the dot slip through outer obstacles before it contracts back.

title: Momentum Flip
concept: The dot constantly accelerates forward; each tap instantly reverses its velocity vector, letting you dodge incoming wall spikes that only appear in the current direction of travel.

title: Momentum Flip
